BiblicalUsage: Azbuk was the father of Nehemiah the ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, who repaired the wall by the sepulchres of David. He appears once, named only as a father, and his son's work on the wall is his memorial.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a father is remembered by his son's faithfulness, and Nehemiah son of Azbuk repaired the wall by the tombs of the kings — good work, done in a holy place.
